CustomField.label: Invitee Organisation
CustomField.description:
★R8 SEIM_INVITEE.COMP_NAME. Was a formula reading the attendee's Company__c text; it is now a snapshot, and it is the field that carries the ERD's central correction — a person's employer is a property of *this invitation*, not of the person. Someone who changes jobs between two events shows the right company on each.
Stamped at add time from Account__c.Name where the attendee is linked to a Contact with an Account, and from the attendee's imported Company__c text otherwise. Both sources land here so that every consumer — the approval page, both reports, the All Invitees table — reads one field and never has to ask which kind of invitee it is looking at. Which source was used is legible from whether Account__c is populated.
Known gap: a guest with no Contact still gets free text, so "Acme Corp" and "ACME Corp." remain two organisations for exactly those rows. Linking them to Contacts is what fixes it, one person at a time.
